summary: Output aspect ratio. 'adaptive' inherits the ratio from the first frame or reference video instead of picking one.
combines: If the requested ratio disagrees with the first frame, ModelArk center-crops the input image.
Our default is 16:9; ByteDance's own default is adaptive.
2.5 locks this to adaptive for video editing, video extension, and first-frame or first-and-last-frame tasks. The 2.0 series accepts an explicit ratio for every task type.

usage.what: Sets the output shape. On image-to-video it also decides whether ModelArk center-crops the first frame to fit.
